entry.title: v1.1.0
entry.content:
What's Changed

  • docs: v1.0.0 changelog, Memlake launch post, and version-1.0 docs snapshot by @nicoloboschi in #5550
  • fix(client): stop the export poll loop from overrunning its timeout on Windows by @nicoloboschi in #5568
  • feat/webhook event delivery ids by @nicoloboschi in #5576
  • feat(control-plane): identify dataplane requests with its own User-Agent by @nicoloboschi in #5536
  • feat(extensions): LLM request extension — choose the LLM and credentials of each call server-side by @nicoloboschi in #5578
  • fix(retain): only rebuild observations when a tag change moves their scopes by @nicoloboschi in #5596
  • ci(triage-labels): stop labelling server issues as coding-agents by @nicoloboschi in #5605
  • fix(llm): put the mental-model refresh's reflect calls under its own concurrency cap by @nicoloboschi in #5597
  • fix(litellm): retry on the HTTP status LiteLLM maps, not message keywords by @nicoloboschi in #5604
  • feat(config): one decision-model setup with per-operation overrides by @nicoloboschi in #5607
  • fix(worker): drop the overstated claimable count from [PENDING_BREAKDOWN] by @nicoloboschi in #5608
  • fix(api): stop an abandoned reflect mid-call when its client disconnects by @nicoloboschi in #5610
  • feat(config): Cloudflare Clef and OpenAI Decisions API as decision-model providers by @nicoloboschi in #5613
  • fix(retain): fail a chunk whose reply is not JSON, even 'no facts' prose (#5565) by @nicoloboschi in #5615
  • fix(anthropic): fail fast on refusal stop_reason instead of retrying as invalid JSON by @nicoloboschi in #5616
  • fix(api): re-check mental-model edits under the row lock so the vector matches the stored text by @nicoloboschi in #5619
  • fix(retain): write a held batch when the producer is blocked on the memory budget by @nicoloboschi in #5620
  • feat/recall prefer observations default by @nicoloboschi in #5617
  • fix(llm): skip json_object response_format for z.ai by @nicoloboschi in #5618
  • feat(evals): consolidation eval suite by @nicoloboschi in #5626
  • feat(recall): rank with the decision model when one is set up by @nicoloboschi in #5284
  • fix(consolidation): keep an UPDATE when the same response deletes that observation (#2550) by @nicoloboschi in #5577
  • blog: 50,000 GitHub Stars by @benfrank241 in #5625
  • fix(hermes): default observation_scopes to shared so observations merge across sessions by @nicoloboschi in #5629
  • fix(local-models): build local torch models one at a time, download in parallel (#4420) by @nicoloboschi in #5609
  • fix(retain): don't mark facts edited when an unchanged document is re-sent by @nicoloboschi in #5630
  • fix(reflect): re-ask a done document of the wrong shape instead of failing the refresh (#5202) by @nicoloboschi in #5631
  • refactor(recall): rank with one decision-model pass, tell it the question date by @nicoloboschi in #5632
  • fix(consolidation): prompt rules and safety nets found by the consolidation evals by @nicoloboschi in #5627
  • perf(graph): build the stale-cooccurrence live set from candidate pairs only by @nicoloboschi in #5640
  • fix(embed): strip dotenv quotes when reading profile .env files by @nicoloboschi in #5642
  • fix(reflect): a "nothing found" answer needs recall first (#4567) by @nicoloboschi in #5641
  • fix(control-plane): keep uploads visible until the retain they queue finishes (#5310) by @nicoloboschi in #5643
  • feat(extensions): let metering extensions see and gate transfer-archive imports by @cdbartholomew in #5579
  • feat(documents): search document text and show which fields matched by @nicoloboschi in #5633
  • fix(retain): reject async append without document_id at submit time by @nicoloboschi in #5651
  • fix/openai service tier chat completions by @nicoloboschi in #5652
  • fix(retain): reclaim ingress attachments when the write-scope check refuses a retain by @nicoloboschi in #5655
  • ci(release): stop trying to publish the hermes plugin to PyPI by @nicoloboschi in #5654
  • fix(transfer): remap mental-model evidence on documents import by @nicoloboschi in #5657
  • fix(tags): reject an unknown tags_match instead of widening it to "any" (#5371) by @nicoloboschi in #5653
  • fix(tags): one tag-filter rule across knowledge base, entities and control plane (#5417) by @nicoloboschi in #5656
  • fix(embeddings): avoid the sentence-transformers 5.4+ dimension FutureWarning by @nicoloboschi in #5660
  • fix(api): port the LlamaParse connector to the v2 parse API by @nicoloboschi in #5659
  • fix/import bank bounded batches by @nicoloboschi in #5661
  • fix(codex): default to a model ChatGPT accounts can use, and stop wasting quota per call by @nicoloboschi in #5658
  • fix(api): measure durations with a monotonic clock, ban time.time() via ruff by @nicoloboschi in #5662
  • fix(api): close bank-validator gaps from #5448 by @nicoloboschi in #5663
  • fix(control-plane): a dataplane 401 no longer sends a valid session to login (#5452) by @nicoloboschi in #5667
  • fix(mental-models): accept a delta array the provider already parsed by @nicoloboschi in #5669
  • fix(memories): tell a store which reranker recall uses; export a store-owned fact's id by @nicoloboschi in #5671
  • feat(documents): change observation_scopes on existing documents with PATCH (#5309) by @nicoloboschi in #5668
  • fix(retain): keep an unset event_date across reprocess and edit by @nicoloboschi in #5670
  • feat(control-plane): download a knowledge page or mental model as PDF or Markdown by @nicoloboschi in #5679
  • fix(reflect): keep facts read through expand in citations and based_on by @nicoloboschi in #5677
  • fix(api): probe banks for consolidation work without seq-scanning memory_units by @nicoloboschi in #5672
  • feat(control-plane): newest/oldest toggle on the timeline view by @nicoloboschi in #5681
  • fix(mcp): let the recall tool return source chunks, entities and source facts by @nicoloboschi in #5678
  • fix(retain): resume a partially written oversized document slice by slice by @nicoloboschi in #5676
  • fix(mental-models): delta refresh fixes a changed value everywhere on the page (#5228) by @nicoloboschi in #5680
  • fix(usage): keep cached and thinking tokens in reflect and retain totals by @nicoloboschi in #5675

  • feat(helm): add extraObjects for deploying arbitrary extra manifests by @nicoloboschi in #5687

entry.title: v1.0.0
entry.content:
What's Changed

  • fix(docs): overview hero reaches the window edges on wide screens by @nicoloboschi in #5440
  • docs: changelog and blog post for v0.10.3 by @nicoloboschi in #5435
  • docs: fix the home page link preview by @nicoloboschi in #5441
  • docs(blog): plain post titles with a description subtitle and byline row by @nicoloboschi in #5460
  • fix(ui): hide the no-op '+field' button at the entity-label root level by @cdbartholomew in #5450
  • refactor(openclaw)!: remove the agent-sdk package and the agent_knowledge_* tools by @nicoloboschi in #5462
  • fix(api): refuse tag-scoped callers on operations answered for the whole bank by @cdbartholomew in #5463
  • docs(grok-bot): the marketplace listing is not approved yet by @benfrank241 in #5465
  • blog: Grok Bot Can Read What Your Other AI Tools Already Learned by @benfrank241 in #5461
  • chore(deps): bump handlebars to 4.7.10 in eliza integration by @cdbartholomew in #5482
  • chore(deps): bump pydantic-ai-slim to 1.107.7 in pydantic-ai integration by @cdbartholomew in #5483
  • chore(deps): bump banks to 2.5.1 in llamaindex integration by @cdbartholomew in #5484
  • chore(deps): bump handlebars to 4.7.10 in root lockfile by @cdbartholomew in #5481
  • fix(integrations): claude-code chunk loss + timestamps, cursor Windows hooks, zed native MCP url by @nicoloboschi in #5506
  • fix(coding-agents): Windows hooks and spawns, pi session cwd, git log parsing by @nicoloboschi in #5511
  • fix(openclaw): drop the bankMission schema default so it stops overwriting bank missions by @nicoloboschi in #5512
  • fix(coding-agents): session-start survey/reflect gating, shared-bank page scope, initiative markers by @nicoloboschi in #5510
  • fix(coding-agents): memory injection on long prompts, empty first recalls, dsh repeats and Grok Build by @nicoloboschi in #5514
  • fix(openclaw): retain from plugin copies OpenClaw never started by @nicoloboschi in #5517
  • fix(control-plane): fix the next build type error in the entity-labels editor by @nicoloboschi in #5518
  • fix(coding-agents): keep retained sessions whole (pi runs, failed ops, exit, btw sessions, codex startup) by @nicoloboschi in #5508
  • fix(openclaw): read the ended transcript through OpenClaw's reader on session_end by @nicoloboschi in #5522
  • fix(api): consolidation discovery probe, mental-model edit race, LlamaParse v2 by @nicoloboschi in #5513
